name: linguist-languages 9.4.0
note: GitHub Linguist is the language classifier behind syntax highlighting and language
statistics on every repository on GitHub, so its list is the closest thing to a
registry that programming languages have. There is no ISO body here -- the set is a
curated judgement -- but it is a *published, versioned, reviewed* judgement rather
than one made in this repository, which is the property that matters.
Taken via the npm redistribution rather than linguist's own languages.yml, for two
reasons: GitHub's source tarballs are not byte-stable across regeneration, so there
is nothing durable to pin a hash to, and languages.yml would need a YAML parser
where this ships plain ES modules node imports natively.
